# Living Water (John 4:14)

## Emotional Focus
Jesus gives us joy that never runs out.

## Key KJV
“Whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst.” (John 4:14)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus told a woman at the well that He could give living water. Whoever drinks it will never be thirsty again.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus sitting by the well talking kindly to the woman; jar of water and bright sunlight.

## Read-along flow + response
“Jesus gives water that fills your heart forever.”
